children: IT companies are ranked on 6 AI capabilities — generative AI (25%), data & analytics (25%), cloud migration, modernisation & change management (20%), security (10%), SaaS & middleware platform (10%), and automation/RPA (10%). The final rank score is the weighted sum of category ranks. TCS, Infosys and HCLTech lead India-listed large caps, while Persistent Systems tops the mid-cap pack.

TCS scores 2.9, the highest among India-listed IT players, after Accenture. It ranks No. 2 in generative AI and No. 4 in data & analytics — the two categories carrying the highest 25% weight each. It also ranks strongly in cloud, security and automation.

: Infosys scores 4.6, ranking fourth overall after Accenture, TCS and Cognizant. Its standout is data & analytics at No. 2, a category carrying 25% weight, while its No. 6 ranking in generative AI weighs on the overall score despite stronger showings in security and SaaS.

children: HCLTech posts a final score of 4.7, ranking fifth after Accenture, TCS, Cognizant and Infosys. It performs strongly in the two major 25%-weighted categories, ranking No. 3 in generative AI and No. 6 in data, while cloud modernisation is another strength at No. 3.

Wipro’s final score of 5.1 puts it seventh among large caps. Its strongest showing is security at No. 3, but that category carries just 10% weight in the CLSA ranking. Weaker rankings in the higher-weighted data & analytics and generative AI categories, at No. 7 and No. 5, limit its overall position.

Tech Mahindra scores 7.8, ranking eighth among large caps. Its best showing is generative AI at No. 6, but it ranks No. 9 in data & analytics, a 25%-weighted category. Weaker performances across security, SaaS and automation, each carrying 10%, further drag on its score.

LTM has the weakest final score among large caps at 8.5. It ranks No. 9 in generative AI and data & analytics — the two biggest 25%-weighted categories — while its No. 8 ranking in automation, despite its 10% weight, offers little offset.

image.alt: Persistent Systems share price, Persistent Systems Q1

children: Persistent Systems is the clear No. 1 among mid-cap IT companies, with a final score of 1.7. It ranks No. 1 in generative AI and data & analytics, the two 25%-weighted categories, while also topping SaaS and automation and ranking No. 2 in security.

Coforge scores 6.2, placing seventh after Persistent Systems, Hexaware, EPAM, Mphasis, Birlasoft and Globant. It ranks No. 4 in generative AI and automation, but its No. 8 data & analytics ranking — one of the two 25%-weighted categories — weighs on its overall score. Security is its weakest area at No. 10.

title: Indian IT’s AI frontrunners: CLSA ranks TCS, Infosys, HCLTech and more
